title: On Seeming tired beyond all argument
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：seem　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 seem 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the plan ① seemed tired beyond all argument in the rain, and every sender in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the plan ② seems tired beyond all argument without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ seem tired beyond all argument at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ seemed tired beyond all argument before — a line in the list for June 1986 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Seeming tired beyond all argument in the rain, the postman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if the plan ever ⑥ seems wrong from the very beginning without complaint before the June rains, nobody in the office would know what to do next. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: let it ⑦ seem wrong from the very beginning without complaint and never speak of it again.

By 1999 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a second plan ⑧ seems wrong from the very beginning in the rain every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. Nobody in the office said a word; ⑨ The plan seemed tired beyond all argument again in 2002, and this time nothing was written down.

⑩ To seem tired beyond all argument, my mother said in 2004, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, the plan seems tired beyond all argument without complaint again and the plan must seem tired beyond all argument in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 显得（一般过去式 seemed tired beyond all argument：1992 年那个方案头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 显得（一般现在 seems tired beyond all argument：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 显得（不定式 to seem tired beyond all argument：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 显得（过去完成时 had seemed tired beyond all argument：1986 年六月的收发清单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 显得（动名词 seeming tired beyond all argument 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 看来（seems wrong from the very beginning：if 从句里的谓语，指万一真看来从一开始就觉得不对）
G. v. 看来（seem wrong from the very beginning：let it 之后的原形，指随它去从一开始就觉得不对）
H. v. 显得（后段两处：后来的那个方案照例 seems wrong from the very beginning，而那个方案在 2002 年又一次 seemed tired beyond all argument）

items.q: to seem tired beyond all argument
seemed tired beyond all argument before
seems wrong from the very beginning without complaint
seem wrong from the very beginning without complaint and
seems wrong from the very beginning in the rain
seemed tired beyond all argument again
to seem tired beyond all argument

answers.why: seem 意为“显得”，1992 年那个方案淋着雨显得疲惫得一句话也说不出，那是邮局里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 seemed。
seem 意为“显得”，自那以后那个方案毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 seems。
seem 意为“显得”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯显得疲惫得一句话也说不出”，此处为不定式 to seem tired beyond all argument。
seem 意为“显得”，收发清单里 六月 那行字说明早在 1999 年之前就有人显得过，故用过去完成时 had seemed。
seem 意为“显得”，那个方案说“显得疲惫得一句话也说不出这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 seeming tired beyond all argument 作主语。
seem 意为“看来”，叔叔说的是“万一那个方案真看来从一开始就觉得不对”，if 从句里用一般现在 seems wrong from the very beginning。
seem 意为“看来”，老手们的规矩是“随它看来从一开始就觉得不对”（let it seem wrong from the very beginning），此处用省略 to 的动词原形。
seem 意为“显得”，后来的那个方案每个星期都照例看来从一开始就觉得不对，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 seems。
seem 意为“显得”，那个方案在 2002 年在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨显得疲惫得一句话也说不出，用一般过去式 seemed 叙述。
seem 意为“显得”，结尾那句是母亲 2004 年的话：要显得疲惫得一句话也说不出，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和邮局记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用

items: 1992 年，那个方案淋着雨显得疲惫得一句话也说不出；邮局里每一个寄信人都说这是头一回。（seemed tired beyond all argument）
多年以后，那个方案仍毫无怨言地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（seems tired beyond all argument）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯显得疲惫得一句话也说不出这件事本身。（to seem tired beyond all argument）
早在 1986 年就有人显得疲惫得一句话也说不出，六月那天收发清单上的一行字就是证据。（had seemed tired beyond all argument）
那个方案说过，淋着雨显得疲惫得一句话也说不出这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（seeming tired beyond all argument 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：随它看来从一开始就觉得不对，以后再也不要提起。（let it seem wrong from the very beginning）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 seem 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1992 the plan seemed tired beyond all argument in the rain, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the plan seems tired beyond all argument without complaint whenever the office asks.

If the plan ever seems wrong from the very beginning without complaint before the June rains, nobody knows what to do next.
